# Nitrate
## Function 
```{r}
no3 <- function(std_file, data_file, intercept = NULL, slope = NULL, label_name = "concentration") {

if (is.character(std_file)) {
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric","text", "numeric"))
} else {
std_data <- std_file
}
  

if (is.character(data_file)) {
no3_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text", "text", "numeric"))
} else {
no3_data <- data_file
}
  
# Standard curve
ggplot(std_data, aes(x = Standard, y = od540)) +
geom_point() +
stat_cor(label.y = 1.0, r.accuracy = 0.0001) +
stat_regline_equation(label.y = 0.8) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, colour = "darkgrey") +
labs(x = "Nitrate concentraion (mg/L)", y = "Absorbance (540 nm)") +
theme_bw()
  
#standard curve  
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "2")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(od540 ~ Standard, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od540 ~ Standard, data = std2)
  
# Samples
sample1 <- no3_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od540 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- no3_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od540 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
      
# Blank
mean_blank <- bind_rows(sample1, sample2) %>%
filter(sample == "bl") %>%
pull(concentration) %>%
mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Duplicates
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
# Blank correction
if (!is.na(mean_blank) && mean_blank > 0) {
mean_conc <- mean_conc - mean_blank} 


result <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
result[[label_name]] <- mean_conc
return(result)} 

```

## Nitrate
```{r}
t0_soilno3 <- no3(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std_no3_synthetique-T0.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/no3_synthetique-T0.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationt0"
)

t1_soilno3 <- no3(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std_no3_synthetique-T1.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/no3_synthetique-T1.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationt1"
)

t2_soilno3 <- no3(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std_no3_synthetique-T2.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/no3_synthetique-T2.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationt2"
)
```

## Data transformation
```{r}
#Creating a dataframe without blank
t0_soilno3 <- t0_soilno3 %>% filter(sample != "bl") 

# mg/mL to mg/g soil conversion
# KCl extraction: 1 g of soil in 10 mL of KCl
no3_t0 <- t0_soilno3 %>%
mutate(across(starts_with("concentrationt0"), ~ .x * 0.01, .names = "{.col}_mg_g")) 

no3_t0 <- no3_t0[, c("sample", "concentrationt0_mg_g")]

#Creating a dataframe without blank
t1_soilno3 <- t1_soilno3 %>% filter(sample != "bl") 

# mg/mL to mg/g soil conversion
# KCl extraction: 1 g of soil in 10 mL of KCl
no3_t1 <- t1_soilno3 %>%
mutate(across(starts_with("concentrationt1"), ~ .x * 0.01, .names = "{.col}_mg_g")) 

no3_t1 <- no3_t1[, c("sample", "concentrationt1_mg_g")]

#Creating a dataframe without blank
t2_soilno3 <- t2_soilno3 %>% filter(sample != "bl") 

# mg/mL to mg/g soil conversion
# KCl extraction: 1 g of soil in 10 mL of KCl
no3_t2 <- t2_soilno3 %>%
mutate(across(starts_with("concentrationt2"), ~ .x * 0.01, .names = "{.col}_mg_g")) 

no3_t2 <- no3_t2[, c("sample", "concentrationt2_mg_g")]

no3_tf <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/no3_concentration_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))


no3_total <- no3_t0 %>%
left_join(no3_t1, by = "sample") %>%
left_join(no3_t2, by = "sample") %>%
left_join(no3_tf, by = "sample")

```

```{r}

nitrate_long <- no3_total %>%
pivot_longer(
cols = starts_with("concentration"),
names_to = "time",
values_to = "concmgg") %>%
mutate(
    time = case_when(
      time == "concentrationt0_mg_g"   ~ "T0",
      time == "concentrationt1_mg_g"   ~ "T1",
      time == "concentrationt2_mg_g"   ~ "T2",
      time == "concentrationsoil_mg_g" ~ "TF",
      TRUE ~ time))

# Add block column
nitrate_long$bloc <- sub("([a-z0-9]+)[a-z][0-9]+", "\\1", nitrate_long$sample)

# Add soil column
nitrate_long$soil <- ifelse(grepl("a", nitrate_long$sample), "agricole", 
                  ifelse(grepl("f", nitrate_long$sample), "forestier", NA))

# treatment
nitrate_long$treatment <- as.numeric(sub(".*([0-9])$", "\\1", nitrate_long$sample))

# Add treatment
treatment_map <- c("10^-8", "10^-6", "10^-4", "10^-2", "10^0", "0")
nitrate_long$treatment <- treatment_map[nitrate_long$treatment]
as.factor(nitrate_long$treatment)

nitrate_long$concmgg[nitrate_long$concmgg < 0] <- 0


```

# Nitrification rate
```{r}

nitrif_taux <- nitrate_long %>%
filter(time %in% c("T0", "T2","TF")) %>%         
mutate(concmgkg = concmgg * 1000) %>%        # conversion mg/g to mg/kg
dplyr::select(sample, time, concmgkg, bloc, soil, treatment) %>%
pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = concmgkg) %>%
mutate(rate_mgkg_day_7day = (T2 - T0) / 7) %>%
mutate(rate_mgkg_day_14day = (TF - T0) / 14)               

nitrif_taux$rate_mgkg_day_7day[nitrif_taux$rate_mgkg_day_7day < 0] <- 0
nitrif_taux$rate_mgkg_day_14day[nitrif_taux$rate_mgkg_day_14day < 0] <- 0

nitrif_agri <- nitrif_taux %>%
filter(soil == "agricole")

nitrif_fo <- nitrif_taux %>%
filter(soil == "forestier")

outlier<- nitrif_taux %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("rate_mgkg_day_7day")


#Nitrif crop
model<- lm(sqrt(sqrt(rate_mgkg_day_14day)) ~ treatment, data = nitrif_agri)
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.698
bartlett.test(sqrt(sqrt(nitrif_agri$rate_mgkg_day_14day)), nitrif_agri$treatment)
#p-value 0.1824

#Nitrif Forest
model<- lm(sqrt(rate_mgkg_day_14day) ~ treatment, data = nitrif_fo)
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.698
bartlett.test(sqrt(nitrif_fo$rate_mgkg_day_14day), nitrif_fo$treatment)
#p-value 0.1824

aovagri <- aov(sqrt(sqrt(rate_mgkg_day_14day)) ~ treatment+bloc, data=nitrif_agri)
summary(aovagri)
TukeyHSD(aovagri)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value  Pr(>F)   
#treatment    5 0.5170 0.10341   3.931 0.01207 * 
#bloc         4 0.5725 0.14313   5.441 0.00394 **
#Residuals   20 0.5261 0.02631    

meannitrif<-aggregate(rate_mgkg_day_14day ~ treatment, data = nitrif_agri, mean)
#  treatment rate_mgkg_day_14day
#         0          0.09983162
#     10^-2          0.01869720
#     10^-4          0.03205698
#     10^-6          0.03218013
#     10^-8          0.03812059
#      10^0          0.04766960

diff4_ctl <- (0.03205698/0.09983162)
reduct4 <- 1-diff4_ctl


diff6_ctl <- (0.03218013/0.09983162)
reduct6 <- 1-diff6_ctl


aovforest <- aov(sqrt(rate_mgkg_day_14day) ~ treatment+bloc , data=nitrif_fo)
summary(aovforest)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5 0.0598 0.01197   0.341  0.882
#bloc         4 0.1686 0.04214   1.200  0.342
#Residuals   20 0.7025 0.03512    

```

# Ammonium
## Function 
```{r}
nh4 <- function(std_file, data_file, intercept = NULL, slope = NULL, label_name = "concentration") {

if (is.character(std_file)) {
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric", "text","numeric"))
} else {
std_data <- std_file}
    
if (is.character(data_file)) {
nh4_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text", "text", "numeric"))
} else {
nh4_data <- data_file}
  
#  Remove the 20 mg/L from the standard curve
std_data <- std_data[std_data$Standard != 20, ]

#standard curve  
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "2")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(od660 ~ Standard, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od660 ~ Standard, data = std2)
  
# Sample
sample1 <- nh4_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od660 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- nh4_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od660 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
      
# Mean blank
mean_blank <- bind_rows(sample1, sample2) %>%
  filter(sample == "bl") %>%
  pull(concentration) %>%
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Duplicates
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
#  Blank Correction 
if (!is.na(mean_blank) && mean_blank > 0) {
    mean_conc <- mean_conc - mean_blank} 

  result <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
  result[[label_name]] <- mean_conc
  return(result)}
```

# Mineralization
```{r}
ammonif <- ammonif_taux %>% dplyr::select(sample,bloc,soil,treatment,rate_mgkg_day_14day)
nitrif <- nitrif_taux %>% dplyr::select(sample,bloc,soil,treatment,rate_mgkg_day_14day)

ammonif <- ammonif %>%dplyr::rename(rate_a = rate_mgkg_day_14day)
ammonif$Ammonification<-ammonif$rate_a
nitrif <- nitrif %>%dplyr::rename(rate_n = rate_mgkg_day_14day)
nitrif$Nitrification<-nitrif$rate_n

mineralize <- left_join(ammonif, nitrif, by = c("sample","bloc","soil","treatment"))
mineralize <- mineralize %>% mutate(rate_mineraliz =(Ammonification+Nitrification))
mineralize$mineralization <-mineralize$rate_mineraliz

min_agri <- mineralize %>%
filter(soil == "agricole")

min_fo <- mineralize%>%
filter(soil == "forestier")

#mineralization crop
model<- lm(sqrt(sqrt(rate_mineraliz)) ~ treatment, data = min_agri)
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.0577
bartlett.test(sqrt(sqrt(min_agri$rate_mineraliz)), min_agri$treatment)
#p-value 0.527

#Mineralization Forest
model<- lm(sqrt(rate_mineraliz) ~ treatment, data = min_fo)
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.0686
bartlett.test(sqrt(min_fo$rate_mineraliz), min_fo$treatment)
#p-value 0.4474

aovagri <- aov(sqrt(sqrt(rate_mineraliz)) ~ treatment+bloc, data=min_agri)
summary(aovagri)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5 0.5372 0.10744   1.337  0.289
#bloc         4 0.6149 0.15372   1.913  0.148
#Residuals   20 1.6074 0.08037      

aovforest <- aov(sqrt(rate_mineraliz) ~ treatment+bloc , data=min_fo)
summary(aovforest)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5  5.258   1.052   1.034  0.425
#bloc         4  5.589   1.397   1.375  0.278
#Residuals   20 20.331   1.017   

```

#Plot mineralization
```{r}
# Long format
min_fo <- min_fo %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(Ammonification, Nitrification), names_to = "process", values_to = "value") 
min_agri <- min_agri %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(Ammonification, Nitrification), names_to = "process", values_to = "value") 

# Crop
summary_process <- min_agri %>%
group_by(treatment, process) %>%
summarise(mean_value = mean(value),
se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()),
.groups = "drop")

summary_total <- summary_process %>%
group_by(treatment) %>%
summarise(mean_value = sum(mean_value),
se = sqrt(sum(se^2)),   
process = "Mineralization",
.groups = "drop")

summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_process, summary_total)


couleurs <- c(
  "Ammonification" = "#8ABAD3",       
  "Nitrification" = "#D28CB2",       
  "Mineralization" = "#FD8D3C" )

# Treatment order
summary_all$treatment <- factor(summary_all$treatment, 
                                levels = c("10^0", "10^-2", "10^-4", "10^-6", "10^-8", "0"))

comparaison_lettres <- data.frame(
  treatment = c("0", "10^-8", "10^-6", "10^-4", "10^-2", "10^0"),
  label = c("a", "a", "b", "b", "a", "a"),
  y.position = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)  
)


agribar <- ggplot() + geom_bar(
    data = subset(summary_all, process == "Mineralization"),
    aes(x = treatment, y = mean_value, fill = process),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.5,       
    alpha = 0.3,          
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0 ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = subset(summary_all, process == "Mineralization"),
    aes(x = treatment, ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
    width = 0.15,
    color = "#FD8D3C",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha=0.3) +
  geom_bar(
    data = subset(summary_all, process != "Mineralization"),
    aes(x = treatment, y = mean_value, fill = process),
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width = 0.42,
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = subset(summary_all, process != "Mineralization"),
    aes(x = treatment,
        ymin = mean_value - se,
        ymax = mean_value + se,
        color = process),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha= 0.4) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("10^0" = "D0",
                                   "10^-2" = "D2",
                                  "10^-4" = "D4",
                                  "10^-6" = "D6",
                                  "10^-8" = "D8", 
                                  "0" = "CTL"))+
labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean rate (mg N/kg/day)", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs) +
scale_color_manual(values = couleurs) +
theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
theme(
axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
legend.position = "right",
legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0))  + guides(color = "none") +   geom_text(data = comparaison_lettres,
aes(x = treatment, y = y.position, label = label),
inherit.aes = FALSE,
size = 5, color = "#D28CB2")

color = "gray30",
linewidth = 0) +
geom_errorbar(data = subset(summary_fo, process != "Mineralization"),
aes(x = treatment, ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se, color = process), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6, alpha= 0.4) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("10^0" = "D0", "10^-2" = "D2", "10^-4" = "D4", "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-8" = "D8", "0" = "CTL"))+
labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
scale_fill_manual(values = couleursfo) +
scale_color_manual(values = couleursfo) +
theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0))  + guides(color = "none") 


max_mine <- max(c(summary_fo$mean_value, summary_all$mean_value), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_min <- c(0, max_mine * 1.5)
agribar<- agribar + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_min)
fobar <- fobar + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_min)

minera<-ggarrange(agribar, fobar, ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), legend = "bottom")


ggsave("synthetic_soil/Figures/Fig_4_mineralization_synt.tiff",plot=minera, dpi=600, compression="lzw",   width = 12.07,
  height = 10.01,
  units = "in")
```
